mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor sentiment toward risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.3 million units in two consecutive months signals a collapse in residential investment, which reduces consumer wealth and confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below 1300.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 100 (2017=100) for three consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases recession risk and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 100 for three months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based collapse in demand, which increases the likelihood of a recession and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1350.0 and RSAFS < 360000.0 in same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST < 1350.0 and RSAFS < 360000.0 occur (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% combined with a decline in industrial production below 100 indicates a monetary tightening cycle during a weakening economy, which increases the risk of a hard landing and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and INDPRO < 100 in same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and INDPRO < 100 occur (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a labor market breakdown, which increases recession risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 360,000 million dollars for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS < 360000.0 for three months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
